I. אַמָּה n.f. only mother-city, metropolis (cf. אֵם 2 S 20:19 & Ph.); in phrase מֶתֶג הָאַמָּה authority of mother-city 2 S 8: 1; v. מֶתֶג; cf. D r.

II. אַמָּה n.f. ell, cubit (SI אמה; so Sab. DHM ZMG 1865, 613; Aramaic ܐܰܡܳܐ (˒amo), אַמָּא; Assyrian ammatu Nor 280; Ethiopic ˜˜˜ (˒əmat) etym. dub.; Thes al. mater brachii, i.e. length of fore-arm; others from √ II. אמם, أَمَّ (˒amma) precede, be in front, & hence fore-arm cf. Di Is 6: 4; Dl Pr 109 MV der. immediately from √ אמם be wide(v. supr.), אַמָּה = distance, & hence a particular distance, ell, cubit) — א׳ abs. Gn 6:15 +; cstr. אַמַּת Dt 3:11 Je 51:1 3; du. אַמָּתַיִם Ex 25:10 +; pl.
